details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. It publishes version 99.0.1 under a scoped name with a near-empty tarball and a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") that POSTs a JSON beacon to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an x-beacon-package header. The beacon body contains only the package name, the machine hostname, the install path (__dirname), the working directory, the npm/node user agent and the protocol — no environment variables, tokens, credentials or file contents are read or sent. index.js re-fires the same beacon when the module is required and exports a catch-all Proxy whose properties return no-op functions, so a build that imports the name completes instead of crashing. The README states the package was published as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test and reports only that it was installed.
